title: It's Time To Talk About The Shitting…
text:
by Steve Watson, Modernity News :
Britain now needs signs telling people not to treat the high street like a field in Uttar Pradesh
The “enrichment” we were sold was cuisine, music and vibrant street life. What arrived, in town after town, is a sanitation standard the UN still spends billions trying to wipe out of third world nations.
Open defecation is not a Western urban myth. WHO and UNICEF still count hundreds of millions of people doing it in fields, ditches and open ground. Nigeria sits near the top of the league table. India, despite a national toilet-building drive, still records tens of millions.
TRUTH LIVES on at https://sgtreport.tv/
When you import the people at scale and refuse to enforce the most basic public standards, you import the habit. The footage is now so routine it has become a genre.
The picturesque village of Broxtowe, Nottinghamshire, has been blessed with the kind of diversity that was only previously seen in London:
Africans defecating in residential streets in the middle of the day 🌞💩 pic.twitter.com/GrR5FPCIx3
— Rare | ♻️🇬🇧 (@RareRestore) August 31, 2026
A children’s park is next. Nothing says community cohesion like a man treating a playground as an outdoor latrine and finishing the job by hand.
